name: evoontology-codex
description: Build, evolve and explore evidence-grounded ontologies from analytical goals and project tasks.

interface.shortDescription: Build · Evolve · Explore：从分析目标到语义层与效果展示
interface.longDescription: Prepare questions from user needs, relevant project history and grounded exploration. Build an ontology, record real tasks, validate evolution and explore outcomes with evidence and version comparisons.
defaultPrompt: Build an ontology for this data project and show the result.
Improve this ontology using recent project tasks and show validated changes.
Explore ontology questions, evidence and version outcomes.
